To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the life cycle stage, management style and the characteristics of the leader are the most significant determinants of business strategy in the hospitality industry.

the management style and the characteristics of the leader are influenced by the stage of the organizational life-cycle, and that the strategy of the firm changes according to the stage of its life-cycle.
the management style and strategy of two hospitality corporations, during their transition through life cycle, are different from each other.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a conceptual framework which relates the life cycle concept to the strategic management process.
the development of a model that integrates the life cycle concept, management style, and business strategy, which we hope to apply in future research.
the development of a model for the relationship of the organizational life-cycle with the business strategy and management style.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the management style and strategies of hospitality corporations are affected by the stage of the corporate organizational life cycle.
the life cycle of a corporation is a major factor in determining the strategy of a firm, and the management style of the leader.
the life cycle concept, strategy and management style are interrelated and should be analyzed together.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the strategy of the company is influenced by the management style and by the characteristics of the leader and by the stage of the corporate lifecycle.
the life cycle concept is an effective tool to understand and analyze the development and evolution of an organization.
the life cycle of a firm has a strong effect on the strategy of the firm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a firm's life cycle stage is a significant determinant of its business strategies and management style.
the strategy of a company is influenced by its life cycle stage, management style and characteristics.
the life cycle concept is a powerful tool in understanding how a firm evolves and changes over time, and how this evolution influences its management style, leadership, and strategy.
